items.title: Is Netflix Stock Worth More Than Its Competitors?
items.summary: Netflix (NFLX) keeps more of each sales dollar than almost every company in its peer group. Yet its stock is one of the cheapest in that group. Among five companies, Netflix ranks second on operating margin. It has the fourth-highest price to earnings ratio, which makes it the second cheapest. So is Netflix stock worth more than its competitors.
